summary: Removed roughly 620 words, using whole optional sentences and one whole paragraph and leaving surviving sentences intact. The largest cuts came from the London opening, the Reeve/Quarterly digressions, the generalizing preambles in the death and Nature passages, redundant war-reaction sentences, and the late-paragraph asides. All eight protected excerpts and every essential beat are kept.
